## Adaptations for Torque

The car hierarchy was normalized to Y-up and forward −Z, with a 4.58 m reference length and ground-level wheels. Original exterior/interior door meshes were regrouped by physical side. The two seat assemblies were split into independent left and right triangle groups. Semantic component groups and Russian aliases were added. Source textures and rendered geometry were preserved. The final scene has 202 renderable mesh nodes after the seat split.

Door, hood, engine-cover and wing hinge locations in `car-metadata.json` are illustrative estimates for interaction, not certified mechanism data. The source model does not contain a fully modeled operational engine or every hidden fastener; any supplemental engineering illustrations should be identified as such by the application.
